data.value: Fills missing overview, genres and production countries without overwriting existing values. Chinese items only. Default is OFF.

data.name: MetadataEnhanceOptions_EnableMdbListCriticRating_Description
data.value: Writes the Rotten Tomatoes score to the critic rating (CriticRating) without touching the community rating. Requires an MdbList API key. Default is OFF.

data.value: Writes the Douban rating to ProviderIds for Kodi skins without touching the community rating. Default is OFF.

data.value: Only updates items whose premiere date falls within this many days. 0 disables the limit. Default is 365 days.

data.value: Douban open-platform V2 token. The official API is preferred when set and covers overview, rating, genres, regions, and languages. Cast and posters still come from web pages / search suggestions, so a Cookie may still be needed. Default is empty.

data.name: MetadataEnhanceOptions_MdbListApiKey_Description
